zh: 新手引导第一步回到真实首页：在真实输入框里逐字输入问题，再在真实对话区流式显示回答，不发真实请求，结束后原来的对话和草稿原样恢复。
工具页面按画面实际宽高铺满并缩放到 80%，能看到更多内容，高亮框随之对准重点元素；引导文案更简短，不再出现“示范”“已匿名”等标注。
en: The first tour step is back on the real home page: the question is typed into the real composer and the reply streams into the real conversation view, without sending a real request. Your open conversation and draft are restored afterwards.

Tool pages in the tour now fill the available space at 80% zoom so more content is visible, with the highlight following the key element. Tour text is shorter and no longer labels screens as demos or anonymized.
